For the enchantments in Dungeons, see MCD:Enchantment.

An enchantment is an augment placed on gear by applying enchantment points. Gear can only be enchanted by going to an enchantsmith and applying an enchantment book. Each enchantable item can only hold one enchantment.

Obtaining

Enchantments are obtained through enchantment books, which are dropped from obsidian chests at the end of dungeons and rifts and rarely from rare chests. Upon obtaining an enchantment book, heroes can return to an enchantsmith to apply it to their gear. All enchantments can be obtained from the ravines, while certain enchants can be obtained from rifts and dungeons in the Overworld.

Usage

Enchantments offer a variety of bonuses to the items they're imbued on. Some enchantments increase a stat, while others add new abilities entirely to weapons or armor.

List of enchantments

There are a total of 34 enchantments of which 32 are obtainable in game, and they can be viewed in the collections tab.
